profile.headline: Software Engineer at Protective Life
profile.summary: An innovative, highly motivated, results-oriented Information Technology Manager with 25 years experience in Call Center Support, Quality Assurance Testing, Documentation, Requirements Gathering, and Development Methodology. Effective organizational, leadership, project management, business analysis, diagnostic, team building, data analytics, and computer skills.  Excellent communication skills and ability to work with all levels of personnel within an organization.

positions.title: Supervisor, Business Analysis/Intelligence - Information Technology
positions.description:
- Collaborate with team to develop and enhance BI product solutions including design, architecture, unit testing, and future releases.
- Design and develop stored procedures/views in SQL for front end consumption.
- Design, create, and deliver SSAS tabular models using Microsoft BI Stack.
- Design and develop Power BI reports for internal and external customers per customer requirements and established guidelines.
- Create calculated columns and measures using DAX in tabular model and Power BI reports.
- Collaborate with data warehouse ETL team to identify data fields required for report development and provide data requirements/existing data relationships.
- Manage and lead project to rewrite existing Crystal reports and Congo’s reports to Power BI.
- Build and maintain relationships and provide training and support to internal customers as well as Power BI Developer team members.

positions.title: Operations Supervisor
positions.description:
- Collaborate with business owners, departmental users, and information technology to provide solutions and drive results.
- Manage, prioritize, and direct workflow and projects of business analysts, operations specialists, and report writers.
- Manage/lead projects through requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and training.
- Communicate new processes, procedures, and customer needs to the organization.
- Manage the coordination of testing projects it meet Sarbanes Oxley requirements and other internal controls.
- Design, create, and maintain Crystal reports using SAP Business Objects and SQL.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
•  Gather and define requirements for system changes/enhancements, new business processes, and software needs.
•  Develop test plans for system changes/enhancements.
•  Test system changes/enhancements.
•  Provide training and support for system enhancements and business processes.
•  Design and create reports using Crystal 2008.
•  Perform statistical and trend analysis on claims data.
•  Special Projects.

positions.title: Agent
positions.description:
Present and sell life and supplemental health insurance to prospective customers (individuals and small businesses) based on needs analysis. 

Customer Service - prepare claiims paperwork, assist customers in making changes to policy information, etc.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager
positions.description:
1. Managed up to 45 people (including an Assistant Manager and 3 Supervisors). 
2. Provided first level support, quality assurance testing, and documentation for in-house mainframe computer applications for employees in 31 regional offices worldwide. 
3. Provided first level support, quality assurance testing, and documentation for up to five web sites for customers worldwide. 
4. Escalated issues as needed and maintained communication with customers and technical teams. Utilized Test Director, NetSuite CRM, and in house programming agenda to track issues. 
5. Worked with internal offices and customers on beta testing new products.
